items.source_en:
A day I always feared came last night. Vaeric turned against me. He abandoned his duties to House Veth'aal, and rejected the Great Serpent Himself. He is a heretic, and yet in that moment, I found myself unable to carry out his sentence. I simply watched him walk away. 

I mourn the loss of my daughter and countless others in silence. A House Elder must remain strong for the sake of their people. But never could I have foreseen such an offense from my own son at a time like this. My anger almost surpasses my grief.

I have always believed the Great Serpent tests His most loyal subjects. I am not surprised to find it my turn, but still I let my son turn his back on me and walk away. Have I failed? And if so, is redemption within reach?
